The '''1993–94 Primeira Divisão''' was the [[Primeira Liga#All-time Primeira Liga table|60th edition]] of top flight of Portuguese football. It started on 22 August 1993 with a match between [[G.D. Estoril-Praia|Estoril-Praia]] and [[S.C. Beira-Mar|Beira-Mar]], and ended on 2 June 1994. The league was contested by 18 clubs with [[FC Porto|Porto]] as the defending champions.

[[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]] won their 30th league title and qualified for the [[1994–95 UEFA Champions League]] group stage. Porto qualified for the [[1994–95 European Cup Winners' Cup]] first round, and [[Sporting CP]], [[Boavista F.C.|Boavista]] and [[C.S. Marítimo|Marítimo]] qualified for the [[1994–95 UEFA Cup]]; in opposite, [[F.C. Paços de Ferreira|Paços de Ferreira]], [[F.C. Famalicão|Famalicão]] and [[G.D. Estoril-Praia|Estoril-Praia]] were relegated to the [[Liga de Honra]]. [[Rashidi Yekini|Yekini]] was the top scorer with 21 goals.

==Promotion and relegation==

===Teams relegated to [[Liga de Honra]]===
*[[F.C. Tirsense|Tirsense]]
*[[S.C. Espinho|Espinho]]
*[[G.D. Chaves|Chaves]]

Tirsense, Espinho and Chaves, were consigned to the Liga de Honra following their final classification in [[1992–93 Primeira Divisão|1992-93 season]].

===Teams promoted from Liga de Honra===
*[[C.F. Estrela da Amadora|Estrela da Amadora]]
*[[C.F. União|União da Madeira]]
*[[Vitória F.C.|Vitória de Setúbal]]

The other three teams were replaced by Estrela da Amadora, União da Madeira, Vitória de Setúbal from the Liga de Honra.
